# Soompi

> > Soompi is the leading English-language source for Korean entertainment news, covering K-pop, K-dramas, variety shows, and celebrity updates.

Soompi provides comprehensive coverage of the Korean entertainment industry, featuring breaking news about K-pop groups like Stray Kids and IVE, drama series such as Voice and Happiness, and variety shows. The site serves as a primary resource for international fans seeking the latest updates on Korean celebrities, music releases, drama premieres, and entertainment industry developments.

## Key Topics

- K-pop (Korean Pop Music)
- K-drama (Korean Drama Series)
- Korean Entertainment Industry
- Stray Kids
- IVE
- Music Bank
- Viki (Streaming Platform)
- Celebrity News & Announcements
- Drama Previews & Reviews
- Variety Shows
- Music News & Releases
- Instagram & Social Media Updates
- Korean Celebrities
- Entertainment Premieres
